footprint_accounting.scope: Offline projected Float32 centers, initial declared camera/1080p/DPR1; nominal circular footprints, not measured raster occlusion.

metric_scopes.cold: Fresh isolated Chrome navigation, empty browser cache; existing running SQLite fixture. First100k submitted/published render observed via MCP; native Pause subsequently verifies interaction. Not Docker build/startup, GPU fence or monitor presentation.
metric_scopes.steady: 30-second requested sleep plus MCP sample boundary overhead, after3-second warmup; all100k submitted. No builds/tests concurrently.
metric_scopes.actions: Population follows actual camera, includes empty region and return; includes read-only full-set numeric/frustum/resource probes; not a clean dynamic hardware SLA.
metric_scopes.apply: Synchronous layer.update, including explicit eviction; large staged commit measured separately.
metric_scopes.preparation_wall: Promise wall duration including yields, not CPU stall.
metric_scopes.preparation_slice_max: Distribution of sampled cumulative sliceMaxMs at successful commits; not a per-slice histogram.
metric_scopes.heap: Chrome performance.memory without forced GC; not browser RSS/driver memory.
metric_scopes.footprint: Offline nominal circles, not raster occlusion.
metric_scopes.provider: Cumulative since isolated fixture startup; hardware/software share the provider. Builder label means no active catalog builder during measurements; fixture SQLite was generated before serving.

limitations: Driver memory not measured; nominal GPU attribute bytes exclude framebuffer/driver allocation.
JS heap samples without forced GC do not prove arbitrary leak freedom.
Steady timing uses headless RAF with quantized timestamps; dynamic samples include whole-set diagnostics.
Full LOD scan at100000 is up to782 RAF; selected center is prioritized immediately.
